references.text: Here is the instruction to take a tribute to the Lord from the spoils of war—one out of every five hundred from people, cattle, donkeys, and small livestock. This forms the basis for the calculation in verse 37.
These verses describe the total spoils of war and their distribution, including the number of small livestock (675,000), which serves as the basis for the tribute of 675 mentioned in verse 37.

Describes the principle that a portion of offerings and gifts belongs to the Lord and is given to the priests. This establishes the theological foundation for the tribute to the Lord from the spoils of war.
Concerns the tithe of the land and livestock as holy to the Lord. This illustrates the general principle that a part of everything belongs to the Lord.
